name: astrid-workspace
description: Workspace marker for the Astrid repository. Not a real npm package.

@banodoco/timeline-ops.description: Optional private package for timeline authoring primitives (addClip, moveClip, setTimelineTheme). Required only for the `npm run ops` bridge used by AA edit verbs.
@banodoco/timeline-ops.install_note: Install from the sibling banodoco-workspace repository: cd <path-to-banodoco-workspace>/packages/timeline-ops && npm install && npm run build, then `npm link` or copy into node_modules/@banodoco/timeline-ops.

@banodoco/timeline-schema.description: Optional private package providing the Zod-schema-validated timeline config shape. Required by @banodoco/timeline-ops as a peer dependency.
@banodoco/timeline-schema.install_note: Install from the sibling banodoco-workspace repository: cd <path-to-banodoco-workspace>/packages/timeline-schema && npm install && npm run build, then `npm link` or copy into node_modules/@banodoco/timeline-schema.
